subject: Maintaining Speed Part 2
author: Jinno Angelo
body:
I hope that you have gone online and played this game because if you havent noticed where these records are, they are at the scoreboards section when going online. There you will see who has the fastest offline and online laps. I hold some that are top 10 for both online and offline times but most are in the top 20 or top 30. I did have more top 10 laps but there are players there who like to clog the leaderboards with different names. Go online and have fun, it is so much more exciting than just playing offline and beating A.I.

As for the car, Zombie is right. Use the Revenge racer to get the most speed because overall that car can hold the speed better than all the other cars. Even if you dont get a good boost jump, that car will still gain or maintain speed if used correctly.

As for doing the 1:1. I do them just to see where Im going wrong with some tracks. For the most part, that is the whole purpose of it, but people do abuse it too because of the handicap and they stay back as far away as possible so that they arent capped when going for a lap time. However, there are players out there that dont do that and get their times in races. Race in a room with the fastest players in the world and you will see that a 1.42.-- in WMF is possible without glitching. I have a 1.41 there but that was a long time ago and I just recently ran that track a several weeks ago and got 1.42.91 without glitching so it is possible. However, since you may not be able to enter that room just yet, its better if you race with other people who are at your same skill level at the moment so that you can get familiar with the fastest routes in the track. Or you could race Waterball as he never kicks anyone out of his rooms.

I will say that above anything, to be really good at this game, the key to master in maintaining speed and drifting properly. You can get the fastest boost jumps in the world, but if you cant maintain it, you'll be slow. So my advice is this, learn to maintain your speed by drifting properly because once you master that you have just become 3x faster than what you were previously..

subject: But if you want a good drive...
author: SUFFUR
body:
...The Criterion 205, or the Works 202, you have to work for your boost, but drifting becomes an art rather than an arc of speed collection, you can still boost jump, but you only get at the most 280mph, that lasts 2 second or less, though 230 most of the time, but you do hold 205 most of the way, especially running against Revenge Racers, not that you will win, but you drive with every moment, which to me is fun, and not trying to Time Out is a good goal. But going against the big guns and for times, the Revenge Racer FTW.

 Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?
